goal_text: Assess whether the maximum permitted HTTP/2 initial stream flow-control window is greater than the protocol's default initial stream flow-control window. Use authoritative primary technical evidence and a real executable check. Autonomously discover and verify the relevant specification, determine how to extract and interpret the required limits, choose and run a zero-cost verification method, identify material protocol-scope or interpretation limitations, independently verify the consequential result, and produce a decision-quality answer with provenance.
